title.narrative: BEE-LIEVE: Beekeepers Economic Empowerment through Long-term Investments in Entrepreneurship and Value chain in Ethiopia

description.narrative: To enhance income and social benefits of honey value chains actors in Tigray Region of Ethiopia: Using the appropriate combination of asset building, enhanced market participation, increased access to financial products and services, improved value chain coordination, and an enabling environment, the action will lead beekeepers in the region, particularly poor women and landless youth to increased income, empowerment and sustainable household food security and poverty reduction.
